Download the PW Talk app today.]
on_screen_text: टूटी-फूटी इंग्लिश से फ्लूएंट इंग्लिश तक [From broken English to fluent English], Learn to speak English fluently, DOWNLOAD THE PW TALK APP
summary: A driver is surprised when a vegetable vendor speaks fluent English during an argument. The vendor explains he practices 15 minutes daily on the PW Talk app, showing that anyone can learn. The ad invites users to download the app and start for Rs. 7.
